angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 993,877 km at 88.16 pc = 0.15 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 11.3435 +/- 0.0150 mas (same row, RUWE 0.99): 88.16 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.4286 +/- 0.0267 solar radii from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1736 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract): 993,877 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.0373 +/- 0.0368 solar masses from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1736 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5636 +/- 86 K from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1736 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1736 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1736.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.144, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1736 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.148 dex, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1736 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.27068, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1736 (pscomppars): age 9.2 Gyr, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1736 (pscomppars): rotation period 28 d, from Martioli et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...680A..84M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1736 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 4 km/s, from Martioli et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...680A..84M/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
